name: Rasul Panari
title: Full Stack Developer
heroText: I build ERP, CRM, POS and business management apps with React, Node.js and PostgreSQL — from database design to Android packaging.

about.summary: Full Stack Developer with 1+ years of professional experience building and maintaining ERP, CRM, billing and business management applications. I work across React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Prisma — designing REST APIs and database schemas, implementing authentication and role-based access, and supporting multi-tenant systems.

cards.title: The Developer
cards.text: I turn real business workflows — billing, bookings, fees, stock — into fast, reliable web apps that people use every day.

cards.title: The Builder
cards.text: Multi-tenant ERPs, POS systems with offline sync, RBAC, payment, email and SMS integrations, and React apps packaged for Android with Capacitor.

cards.title: The Stack
cards.text: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Prisma — deployed and maintained on Render and Cloudflare.
